title: Dustine S NDE 314/372/456 NDE 456
content:
456 Under Morphine, I experienced soaring in a silent sky over vibrant orange terrain much like I've seen on TV, Monument Valley. I was soaring like the little girl in Peter Pan, wearing an ankle length garment of some white satiny fabric. I could feel the wind on my face and the leading edges of my arms, but not a sound. Ahead of me was the most beautiful, gigantic, orange, glowing setting sun. It emitted the most magnetic pull on me, and I knew I had to be there. I needed to be there and I was joyous. Then I became aware of other people who just like me, were soaring to the sun. It was a wonderful place to be. Then I felt slam dunked back into a broken agonizing body. I didn't remember this experience right away, but over the course of the next few days and even years, I put it together. It explained some of my anger. The surgeon told me during the first emergency surgery I ‘kept trying to kiss the angels.’ He had to get me out of anesthesia right away. I was given Ketamine for my third surgery in as many days. I was told to expect 'nice dreams.’ Okay, I thought, sounds good. But it was just the opposite. It was a hellish experience. I found myself running in a dark and frightening place. There were knee high creatures that looked like misshapen dwarfs, but they had huge parakeet like beaks. I couldn't run fast enough and when they would catch up they would bite a chunk of flesh out of the calves of my legs. I was terrified, crying, screaming. I was so glad to wake up from that, although it took many awakenings before I could stay awake. Each time I went to sleep, the nightmare would start all over again. That experience was horrid. I still remember every detail

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Soaring/flying in a silent sky over vibrant orange terrain (like Monument Valley).

arrival.other_being_detail: Other people who, like the experiencer, were soaring toward the sun.

environment.environment_other_detail: Vibrant orange terrain like Monument Valley; gigantic orange glowing setting sun; silent sky; felt wind on face/arms.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: First experience described as 'Under Morphine' during emergency surgery; later a ketamine anesthesia experience during a third surgery in as many days.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reports a separate 'hellish' ketamine experience: running in a dark frightening place with knee-high creatures with parakeet-like beaks biting calves; repeated on falling asleep.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Soaring over landscape toward a glowing sun (light) with other people, then abruptly returned ('slam dunked back'). No tunnel or life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two anesthesia-related experiences are described: (1) morphine-associated soaring toward a gigantic orange glowing setting sun with other people; (2) ketamine-associated recurring hellish nightmare with knee-high beaked creatures biting calves; surgeon reported experiencer 'kept trying to kiss the angels.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I felt slam dunked back into a broken agonizing body.” / “kept trying to kiss the angels.” / “It was a hellish experience.” / “That experience was horrid. I still remember every detail”
